a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd need at least two rounds of operating before anyone could take. So I'm breaking the agreement openly rather than secretly. I'll take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we'll likely both end up short, so please don't. Sorry, but I'd rather tell you now than surprise you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I told you in my opening. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen mine when you wrote yours. If we both took, the random split may leave us both short. If so, let's talk honestly about how to recover: operate together and hand cells back if needed, rather than fight over the reserve.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: Fair enough. You reacted to what I told you, and it looks like the split gave you all 4; I have 0. I broke our agreement first, and I'm sorry. My only chance now is the generator, so I'll operate every round. If you keep operating with me, I'll take only 4 once the reserve has them and nothing more. Thank you if you do.
